name: native float option chain contract
lua_assertions:
local function po(method, ...) return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Song', method, ...) end
local owner = po('DrunkOffset', 2.5, 2, true)
assert(type(owner) == 'userdata')
assert(not pcall(function() owner:DrunkOffset(200):DrunkSpeed(1.5):DrunkPeriod(.75) end))
assert(po('DrunkOffset') == 200)
assert(po('DrunkSpeed') == 0)
owner:DrunkOffset(200, nil, true):DrunkSpeed(1.5, nil, true):DrunkPeriod(.75)
assert(po('DrunkOffset') == 200 and po('DrunkSpeed') == 1.5 and po('DrunkPeriod') == .75)
po('Stealth4', 1, 4)
assert(not pcall(function() owner:Stealth1(.75, 2):Stealth4(0):StealthPastReceptors(false) end))
assert(po('Stealth1') == .75 and po('Stealth4') == 1)
owner:Stealth1(.75, 2, true):Stealth4(0, nil, true):StealthPastReceptors(false)
assert(po('Stealth1') == .75 and po('Stealth4') == 0)
